_key.description: The two NCBI Entrez gene IDs in canonical order and coxpresdb, joined by underscores. Ensembl IDs are used instead when either gene maps to more than one Ensembl identifier.

_from.description: Handle of the first gene in the pair (smaller Entrez ID).

_to.description: Handle of the second gene in the pair (larger Entrez ID).

z_score.description: COXPRESdb coexpression z-score. 0 is random-level coexpression; 3 is a false-positive rate of 0.1%. Larger absolute values mean stronger coexpression. Only pairs with absolute value of 3 or greater are loaded.

associated_process.description: Gene Ontology term for gene expression, as a handle into ontology_terms.

files_filesets.description: Handle of the files_filesets record for the COXPRESdb coexpression bundle this pair was read from.

accessible_via.return: z_score, associated_process, source, source_url, method, class, label, files_filesets
